links.outcome: Side-by-side comparison of two ambient scribe products on edit time, errors, and ratings
links.effect: Product A draft notes took significantly longer to edit, had fewer omissions, and more additions and irrelevant or misplaced text errors than Product B; Product A was rated as performing better for most encounters.
links.quote: Ambient Digital Scribe Product A draft notes took significantly longer to edit, had fewer omissions, and more additions and irrelevant or misplaced text errors than ADS Product B.

links.outcome: Errors (omissions, additions, irrelevant or misplaced text) in AI-generated ambient scribe draft notes
links.effect: Both products' draft notes contained errors; Product A had fewer omissions but more additions and irrelevant or misplaced text errors than Product B.
links.quote: Ambient Digital Scribe Product A draft notes took significantly longer to edit, had fewer omissions, and more additions and irrelevant or misplaced text errors than ADS Product B.

screen.reason: Empirical study testing simulation testing as a pre-deployment evaluation method for comparing two ambient clinical documentation tools on safety and editing effort.
